The ACLU dares to create a more perfect union – beyond one person, party, or side. Our mission is to realize this promise of the United States Constitution for all and expand the reach of its guarantees. For over 100 years, the ACLU has been our nation’s guardian of liberty, working in courts, legislatures, and communities to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States. jobs.description_text: HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Curious, enthusiastic, detail-obsessed and proactive, the Paid Media Graduate sits at the centre of one of ZURU's fastest-growing media channels. This is an entry-level role built for a recent graduate – or someone with up to a year of experience – who learns fast, takes genuine ownership of their work, and is relentless about getting the details right. Day to day, you’ll manage the clipping budget across the ZURU brand portfolio, work hand in hand with our agency partners to brief, launch and optimise campaigns, and own the clipping dashboard that the whole business reads. You won’t need platform experience to begin, but you’ll be hungry to learn it. Over time you’ll grow into the person who makes the call on where the money goes – using cost per thousand views, creator quality and brand fit to steer spend – and who helps build clipping from a promising test into a standing media capability, and ultimately a media venture in its own right. Who We Are 

OpenEye, the cloud video platform company, provides solutions for video security, business intelligence and loss prevention. For over 20 years, OpenEye has been committed to developing an easy-to-use, comprehensive video management system backed by Heroic Customer Service® and support.  Our on-site and cloud-based products can be found protecting schools, hospitals, banks, retail stores, and other facilities around the world. OpenEye’s solutions are available globally through a trusted network of certified service providers. 

OpenEye is a subsidiary of Alarm.com. Learn more at www.openeye.net.
